instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 375°F. Line two large baking sheet pans with parchment paper. (Bake in batches, if necessary, depending on the size of your baking sheets.)
Cut butter into small pieces. Place in a large bowl and set aside to soften.
Place flour, baking powder, and salt in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dry ingredients and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ¾ cups all-purpose flour
½ tsp baking powder
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place egg and vanilla in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the wet ingredients and set aside.
Once the butter has softened, add sugar to the bowl and beat with a hand mixer on medium-high until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes. Scrape down the sides of the bowl with a silicone spatula.
Add wet ingredients to the bowl with the butter mixture. Mix on medium speed until fully combined. Scrape down the sides of the bowl.
Add dry ingredients to the bowl. Mix on low speed until just combined.

Using a cookie scoop or tablespoon measure, drop rounded scoops of dough onto the baking sheets, spacing them 1 ½-inches apart. Using a clean, moistened finger or handle of a wooden spoon, make an indentation in the middle of the dough, creating a divot.
Fill each divot with ½ a teaspoon of preserves.
Place baking sheets in the oven and bake until cookies start to turn golden around the edges, 14-16 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool.
To serve, transfer cookies to a platter. Enjoy!
